decisions.decision: Execute this phase sequentially on the main working tree with worktrees disabled
decisions.rationale: Greenfield Electron project with native modules (better-sqlite3): node_modules is gitignored, so worktree isolation would force a full npm install plus Electron native rebuild in each of six waves and destroy it on cleanup. Only Wave 2 had any parallelism to gain. Sequential installs node_modules once (in 01-01) and reuses it for every later plan. Kept scoped to this run; workflow.use_worktrees was NOT persisted to false.

decisions.decision: UI wired against @base-ui/react 1.6.0 (Base UI), not classic Radix, with a TooltipProvider at the tree root
decisions.rationale: The shadcn base-nova registry resolved @base-ui/react during 01-03 rather than Radix. Pinned exact. 01-06 wired components and the provider accordingly. Downstream UI phases must follow this.

notable_findings: 01-07 caught and fixed a real production bug: the packaged preload was bundling node_modules/electron/index.js (the executable-path shim) instead of the runtime built-in, leaving window.api undefined at renderer boot (latent since 01-06). Fixed by marking electron external in the preload build in electron.vite.config.ts. This unblocks every downstream renderer feature and Phase 8 packaging.
electron-vite 5 peer range tops out at vite 7 while the pinned vite is 8.1.5; resolved with .npmrc legacy-peer-deps (no package substituted), build verified functional.
TypeScript 7.0.2 removed tsconfig baseUrl; path maps were migrated to relative form in 01-02.
